flaw: Season K/9 was treated like an edge while the opponent was making contact, around .250 against him, and a prior meeting produced hits.
rule: Contact against the pitcher is a miss in the registry. It does not ban the market. It has to be offset by other alignments.

flaw: Boston moneyline was scored off one starter. The Yankees won Game 1 9-0 and led Game 2 9-2. The other arm was live and Boston's bats were not stacked on the card.
rule: A moneyline is a registry: starter, other starter, season bats, last-5 hot bats, and the posted price. More alignments raise it. One number cannot print a 70.
